english: Dealing Grenade Damage to a Glyphkeeper grants 20%|25%|35|40%|40% increased damage for 15 seconds with Hand Cannons, Shotguns, Grenade Launchers, and Rocket Launchers.

source.text:
Upon dealing Grenade Damage to a Glyphkeeper:

20% | 25% | 35 | 40% | 40% increased damage for 15 seconds.

Applicable Weapons:
Hand Cannons, Shotguns, Grenade Launchers, Rocket Launchers.
